_help: Products for the shop sections on gear.html. Run: python3 tools/gear_shop.py. Amazon items need only an ASIN (links and photos use the Amazon Associates tag). Brand items use the brand's own product handle, price and photo. Never put passwords or API secrets in this file, it is public.

jlab._help: Leave direct_template blank to send JLab buttons to Amazon with the steelgames-20 tag. Once the JLab affiliate link is approved on Impact, paste the tracking link here with {url} where the jlab.com product address goes, for example https://jlab.sjv.io/XXXX?u={url} and the JLab buttons will go to jlab.com instead.
